verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מֹועֵ֑ד בְּאֶחָד֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית לְצֵאתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى فِي بَرِّيَّةِ سِينَاءَ، فِي خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ، فِي أَوَّلِ ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلثَّانِي فِي ٱلسَّنَةِ ٱلثَّانِيَةِ لِخُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ قَائِلًا:
verses.en: AND THE LORD spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first [day] of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.he: שְׂא֗וּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֙ כָּל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֔ות כָּל־זָכָ֖ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: «أَحْصُوا كُلَّ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ بِعَشَائِرِهِمْ وَبُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ، بِعَدَدِ ٱلْأَسْمَاءِ، كُلَّ ذَكَرٍ بِرَأْسِهِ،
verses.en: 'Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of names, every male, by their polls;
verses.kjv: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of [their] names, every male by their polls;
verses.web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

verses.he: מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛ם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם אַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.ar: مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا، كُلَّ خَارِجٍ لِلْحَرْبِ فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ. تَحْسُبُهُمْ أَنْتَ وَهَارُونُ حَسَبَ أَجْنَادِهِمْ.
verses.en: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: ye shall number them by their hosts, even thou and Aaron.
verses.kjv: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.web: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

verses.he: וְאִתְּכֶ֣ם יִהְי֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ לַמַּטֶּ֑ה אִ֛ישׁ רֹ֥אשׁ לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖יו הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: وَيَكُونُ مَعَكُمَا رَجُلٌ لِكُلِّ سِبْطٍ، رَجُلٌ هُوَ رَأْسٌ لِبَيْتِ آبَائِهِ.
verses.en: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe, every one head of his fathers' house.
verses.kjv: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.web: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

verses.he: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמֹ֣ות הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַֽעַמְד֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם לִרְאוּבֵ֕ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ أَسْمَاءُ ٱلرِّجَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقِفُونَ مَعَكُمَا: لِرَأُوبَيْنَ أَلِيصُورُ بْنُ شَدَيْئُورَ.
verses.en: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the names of the men that shall stand with you: of [the tribe of] Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.web: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.he: לְשִׁמְעֹ֕ון שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.ar: لِشِمْعُونَ شَلُومِيئِيلُ بْنُ صُورِيشَدَّاي.
verses.en: Of Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.kjv: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.web: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.he: לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה נַחְשֹׁ֖ון בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.ar: لِيَهُوذَا نَحْشُونُ بْنُ عَمِّينَادَابَ.
verses.en: Of Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.kjv: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.web: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.he: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃
verses.ar: لِيَسَّاكَرَ نَثَنَائِيلُ بْنُ صُوغَرَ.
verses.en: Of Issachar, Nethanel the son of Zuar.
verses.kjv: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.web: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

verses.he: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֹֽן׃
verses.ar: لِزَبُولُونَ أَلِيآبُ بْنُ حِيلُونَ.
verses.en: Of Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.kjv: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.web: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.he: לִבְנֵ֣י יֹוסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֕יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיה֑וּד לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָהצֽוּר׃
verses.ar: لِٱبْنَيْ يُوسُفَ: لِأَفْرَايِمَ أَلِيشَمَعُ بْنُ عَمِّيهُودَ، وَلِمَنَسَّى جَمْلِيئِيلُ بْنُ فَدَهْصُورَ.
verses.en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.kjv: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.web: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.he: לְבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃
verses.ar: لِبَنْيَامِينَ أَبِيدَنُ بْنُ جِدْعُونِي.
verses.en: Of Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.kjv: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.web: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.he: לְדָ֕ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.ar: لِدَانَ أَخِيعَزَرُ بْنُ عَمِّيشَدَّاي.
verses.en: Of Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.kjv: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.web: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.he: לְאָשֵׁ֕ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עָכְרָֽן׃
verses.ar: لِأَشِيرَ فَجْعِيئِيلُ بْنُ عُكْرَنَ.
verses.en: Of Asher, Pagiel the son of Ochran.
verses.kjv: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.web: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

verses.he: לְגָ֕ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: لِجَادَ أَلِيَاسَافُ بْنُ دَعُوئِيلَ.
verses.en: Of Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.kjv: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.web: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.he: לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃
verses.ar: لِنَفْتَالِي أَخِيرَعُ بْنُ عِينَنَ».
verses.en: Of Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.'
verses.kjv: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.web: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

verses.he: אֵ֚לֶּה *קְרִיאֵי (קְרוּאֵ֣י) הָעֵדָ֔ה נְשִׂיאֵ֖י מַטֹּ֣ות אֲבֹותָ֑ם רָאשֵׁ֛י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ هُمْ مَشَاهِيرُ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ، رُؤَسَاءُ أَسْبَاطِ آبَائِهِمْ. رُؤُوسُ أُلُوفِ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: These were the elect of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
verses.kjv: These [ were] the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.web: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמֹֽות׃
verses.ar: فَأَخَذَ مُوسَى وَهَارُونُ هَؤُلَاءِ ٱلرِّجَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعَيَّنُوا بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ،
verses.en: And Moses and Aaron took these men that are pointed out by name.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by [their] names:
verses.web: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

verses.he: וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־הָעֵדָ֜ה הִקְהִ֗ילוּ בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וַיִּתְיַֽלְד֥וּ עַל־מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ות מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَجَمَعَا كُلَّ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ فِي أَوَّلِ ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلثَّانِي، فَٱنْتَسَبُوا إِلَى عَشَائِرِهِمْ وَبُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ بِعَدَدِ ٱلْأَسْمَاءِ، مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا بِرُؤُوسِهِمْ،
verses.en: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.kjv: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first [day] of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.web: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֖ם בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃ פ
verses.ar: كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى. فَعَدَّهُمْ فِي بَرِّيَّةِ سِينَاءَ.
verses.en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so did he number them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.web: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.he: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תֹּולְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמֹות֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.ar: فَكَانَ بَنُو رَأُوبَيْنَ بِكْرِ إِسْرَائِيلَ، تَوَالِيدُهُمْ حَسَبَ عَشَائِرِهِمْ وَبُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ، بِعَدَدِ ٱلْأَسْمَاءِ بِرُؤُوسِهِمْ، كُلُّ ذَكَرٍ مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا، كُلُّ خَارِجٍ لِلْحَرْبِ،
verses.en: And the children of Reuben, Israel's first-born, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.kjv: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.web: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

verses.he: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃ פ
verses.ar: كَانَ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ لِسِبْطِ رَأُوبَيْنَ سِتَّةً وَأَرْبَعِينَ أَلْفًا وَخَمْسَ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Reuben, [were] forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

verses.he: לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעֹ֔ון תֹּולְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם פְּקֻדָ֗יו בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמֹות֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.ar: بَنُو شِمْعُونَ، تَوَالِيدُهُمْ حَسَبَ عَشَائِرِهِمْ وَبُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمِ، ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ بِعَدَدِ ٱلْأَسْمَاءِ بِرُؤُوسِهِمْ، كُلُّ ذَكَرٍ مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا، كُلُّ خَارِجٍ لِلْحَرْبِ،
verses.en: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, those that were numbered thereof, according to the number of names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.kjv: ¶ Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.web: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

verses.he: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְעֹ֑ון תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֹֽות׃ פ
verses.ar: ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ لِسِبْطِ شِمْعُونَ تِسْعَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَثَلَاثُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Simeon, [were] fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

verses.en: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Asher, [were] forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

verses.he: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י תֹּולְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃
verses.ar: بَنُو نَفْتَالِي، تَوَالِيدُهُمْ حَسَبَ عَشَائِرِهِمْ وَبُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ، بِعَدَدِ ٱلْأَسْمَاءِ مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا، كُلُّ خَارِجٍ لِلْحَرْبِ،
verses.en: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.kjv: ¶ Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.web: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

verses.he: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹֽות׃ פ
verses.ar: ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ مِنْهُمْ لِسِبْطِ نَفْتَالِي ثَلَاثَةٌ وَخَمْسُونَ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعُ مِئَةٍ.
verses.en: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Naphtali, [were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.web: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

verses.he: אֵ֣לֶּה הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וּנְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אִ֑ישׁ אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖יו הָיֽוּ׃
verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ هُمُ ٱلْمَعْدُودُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَدَّهُمْ مُوسَى وَهَارُونُ وَرُؤَسَاءُ إِسْرَائِيلَ، ٱثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلًا، رَجُلٌ وَاحِدٌ لِبَيْتِ آبَائِهِ.
verses.en: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men; they were each one for his fathers' house.
verses.kjv: These [are] those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, [being] twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.web: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

verses.he: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ כָּל־פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: فَكَانَ جَمِيعُ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ حَسَبَ بُيُوتِ آبَائِهِمْ مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا، كُلُّ خَارِجٍ لِلْحَرْبِ فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: And all those that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.kjv: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.web: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

verses.he: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאֹ֥ות אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ות וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.ar: كَانَ جَمِيعُ ٱلْمَعْدُودِينَ سِتَّ مِئَةِ أَلْفٍ وَثَلَاثَةَ آلَافٍ وَخَمْسَ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسِينَ.
verses.en: even all those that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.kjv: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.web: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

verses.he: וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֑ם לֹ֥א הָתְפָּקְד֖וּ בְּתֹוכָֽם׃ פ
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ حَسَبَ سِبْطِ آبَائِهِمْ فَلَمْ يُعَدُّوا بَيْنَهُمْ،
verses.en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.kjv: ¶ But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.web: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: إِذْ كَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ אֶת־מַטֵּ֤ה לֵוִי֙ לֹ֣א תִפְקֹ֔ד וְאֶת־רֹאשָׁ֖ם לֹ֣א תִשָּׂ֑א בְּתֹ֖וךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: «أَمَّا سِبْطُ لَاوِي فَلَا تَحْسُبُهُ وَلَا تَعُدَّهُ بَيْنَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: 'Howbeit the tribe of Levi thou shalt not number, neither shalt thou take the sum of them among the children of Israel;
verses.kjv: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.web: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַפְקֵ֣ד אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם֩ עַל־מִשְׁכַּ֨ן הָעֵדֻ֜ת וְעַ֣ל כָּל־כֵּלָיו֮ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֹו֒ הֵ֜מָּה יִשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְהֵ֖ם יְשָׁרְתֻ֑הוּ וְסָבִ֥יב לַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃
verses.ar: بَلْ وَكِّلِ ٱللَّاوِيِّينَ عَلَى مَسْكَنِ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَمْتِعَتِهِ وَعَلَى كُلِّ مَا لَهُ. هُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْمَسْكَنَ وَكُلَّ أَمْتِعَتِهِ، وَهُمْ يَخْدِمُونَهُ، وَحَوْلَ ٱلْمَسْكَنِ يَنْزِلُونَ.
verses.en: but appoint thou the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all the furniture thereof, and over all that belongeth to it; they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the furniture thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.kjv: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that [belong] to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.web: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

verses.he: וּבִנְסֹ֣עַ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יֹורִ֤ידוּ אֹתֹו֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּבַחֲנֹת֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹתֹ֖ו הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃
verses.ar: فَعِنْدَ ٱرْتِحَالِ ٱلْمَسْكَنِ يُنَزِّلُهُ ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ وَعِنْدَ نُزُولِ ٱلْمَسْكَنِ يُقِيمُهُ ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ. وَٱلْأَجْنَبِيُّ ٱلَّذِي يَقْتَرِبُ يُقْتَلُ.
verses.en: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up; and the common man that draweth nigh shall be put to death.
verses.kjv: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.web: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

verses.he: וְחָנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל־מַחֲנֵ֛הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ עַל־דִּגְלֹ֖ו לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَيَنْزِلُ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ كُلٌّ فِي مَحَلَّتِهِ وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَ رَايَتِهِ بِأَجْنَادِهِمْ.
verses.en: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man with his own camp, and every man with his own standard, according to their hosts.
verses.kjv: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.web: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

verses.he: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַחֲנ֤וּ סָבִיב֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה קֶ֔צֶף עַל־עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֽוּת׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ فَيَنْزِلُونَ حَوْلَ مَسْكَنِ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ سَخَطٌ عَلَى جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، فَيَحْفَظُ ٱللَّاوِيُّونَ شَعَائِرَ مَسْكَنِ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ».
verses.en: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of the testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony.'
verses.kjv: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.web: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

verses.he: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ פ
verses.ar: فَفَعَلَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ حَسَبَ كُلِّ مَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى كَذَلِكَ فَعَلُوا.
verses.en: Thus did the children of Israel; according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.web: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.
